versions.changelog:
- 修改每日数据更新时间，从“06:00”调整为“17:00”
- 更新所有相关描述和用户提示，反映新的数据更新时间
- 移除文档文件 skill-card.md

Initial release of douyin-weekly-surge

- Provides a tool to query Douyin's 7-day surge ranking (TOP50 works with the fastest week-over-week likes growth).
- Supports filtering by category (28 available), and up to 30 days of historical data review.
- Default output is the top 20 works (with option to view all 50), results shown in Markdown tables with clickable links.
- Includes clear user prompts for time and category selection, and subscription options for automatic push notifications.
- API authentication via Redfox API Key; detailed usage instructions included.
